description.narrative: The PDO is to strengthen key institutional and regulatory functions of the Ministry of Environment (MOEn). These key functions will enable MOEn to undertake environmental policy analysis and coordination, formulate laws and regulations, monitor environmental quality, promote environmental awareness and conduct technical studies.
